title: Strict coefficient reduction for open image
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, with positive quotients $A_n=\mathcal O_E/\mathfrak m_E^{n+1}$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $j:X\hookrightarrow Y$ be any open immersion of schemes, with completed coefficient sheaves $B_X,B_Y$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Choose coefficient derived-system calculi $S_X,S_Y$, with reduction functors $r_X,r_Y$ and their prescribed evaluations [def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data, def-coef-ringed-sequence-site]. Write $J_j$ for native varying-ring derived extension by zero [def-sp-varying-ring-operations], and $j_B,j_n$ for completed and finite ringed derived extension by zero [def-strict-coefficient-ringed-geometric-data]. There is a natural transformation $\beta_j:j_Br_Y\to r_XJ_j$ of functors on all of $D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},B_X)$. Let $\rho_{W,n}:r_W\operatorname{ev}_n\simeq L(-\otimes_{B_W}A_n)$ be reductionEvaluation followed by inverse finiteReductionIso [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction], and let $e_{j,n}:J_j\operatorname{ev}_n\simeq\operatorname{ev}_nj_n$ be native evaluation transported to the finite ringed presentation [def-weil-compact-support-native-system-evaluation]. For every ambient input $K$ and $n\geq0$, $\operatorname{ev}_n(\beta_j(K));e_{j,n}(r_XK)=\rho_{Y,n}(j_BK);\operatorname{openComparison}_n(K);j_n(\rho_{X,n}^{-1}(K))$. Completeness of $K$ is not assumed. The finite ringed presentation identifications are those of [lem-strict-coefficient-finite-geometric-coordinates].

proof.text: Choose the published strict-system Operations o and its whole-system RealizationModel, whose reduction calculus is pullbackTensorCalculus. No integral object or comparison map is chosen from a mere existence assertion.

The canonical open-adjunction mate model.openReduction is invertible on every ambient derived input, by integralOpenReductionIso. Invert that natural transformation and postcompose with integralNativeOpenIso. This constructs beta on whole strict systems. integralNativeOpenComparison identifies its finite evaluations, and integralOpenFiniteEvaluation identifies the inverse mate. Cancel the evaluated isomorphism and the finite reduction isomorphism to obtain the finite scalar comparison formula in intrinsic constant-ring coordinates.

For arbitrary SX and SY, compare their reductions with the canonical reductions by uniqueness of left adjoints to the fixed total-limit functors. Transposing their unit_projection equations under the finite scalar adjunction proves that these comparisons preserve reductionEvaluation. Conjugate beta by these comparisons. Naturality of native open evaluation and the finite reduction coordinate identities give the same evaluation formula for SX and SY.

Expand openFiniteReduction and the definition of strictCoefficientOpenEvaluation. Move the inverse finiteOpenIso across the open image of the finiteReductionIso/reductionEvaluation composite by naturality and cancel finiteOpenIso with its inverse. This yields precisely the stated ringed finite-coordinate equation for every K and n. No completeness, compactness or constructibility assumption is introduced.

proof_origin.place: Open coefficient identification, using the existing whole-system open reduction isomorphism, its finite evaluation and its native presentation; normalized adjoint-uniqueness transport written in Lean.

lean.statement:
theorem strictCoefficientOpenReduction (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion f]
    (SX : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E X)
    (SY : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E Y) :
    ∃ β : (openExtension (completed l E) f).mapDerivedCategory ⋙ SY.reduction ⟶
        SX.reduction ⋙ ProEtale.VaryingRing.J (compactSupportSystemLevel l E)
          (compactSupportSystemQuotient l E) f,
      ∀ (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E X)) (n : ℕ),
        (coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E Y n).map (β.app K) ≫
            (strictCoefficientOpenEvaluation l E f n).hom.app (SX.reduction.obj K) =
          ((SY.reductionEvaluation n).hom.app
              ((openExtension (completed l E) f).mapDerivedCategory.obj K) ≫
            (finiteReductionIso l E Y n).inv.app
              ((openExtension (completed l E) f).mapDerivedCategory.obj K)) ≫
            (openComparison (reduction l E (n + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 n)) f).app K ≫
            ((openExtension (finite l E (n + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 n)) f).mapDerivedCategory).map
              ((finiteReductionIso l E X n).hom.app K ≫
                (SX.reductionEvaluation n).inv.app K)
